projects.name: MetroMind
projects.tagline: Intelligent Smart Metro Ticketing Platform with ML Crowd Prediction
projects.problem: Urban metro commuters endure long ticket counter queues and face unpredictable train congestion during peak hours without real-time density guidance.
features: Digital metro ticket booking with QR pass generation
commuter crowd density prediction powered by scikit-learn ML models
Dynamic fare calculation based on station distance and train schedules
Dual-backend architecture separating ML analytics from transactional bookings
Clean, responsive commuter dashboard built with React and Vite
projects.role: Solo full-stack engineer: designed database schemas, built React UI, developed Express ticketing service, and trained the Django REST ML crowd prediction microservice.
projects.challenges: Decoupling the ML prediction service from transaction processing to prevent data-heavy machine learning queries from slowing down high-volume ticket checkouts.

projects.name: CinePulse
projects.problem: Casual moviegoers find mainstream movie portals ad-heavy, slow, and lacking unified personal watchlist curation across genres.
features: Real-time movie and TV series search powered by TMDB API proxy
Personalized watchlist and favorites curation stored in PostgreSQL
PL/pgSQL stored procedures for relational data integrity and swift query execution
Rich modal cards with trailers, release details, and actor filmography
Dark-mode cinema aesthetic with smooth UI micro-animations
projects.role: Architected the relational PostgreSQL schemas, authored stored procedures in PL/pgSQL, implemented Express proxy caching, and built the sleek React movie interface.
projects.challenges: Optimizing TMDB API rate-limited queries while keeping user custom lists synchronized in PostgreSQL with zero UI lag.

projects.name: DigiKhata
projects.tagline: Digital Ledger & Accounts Management for Small Merchants
projects.problem: Small shopkeepers and freelance vendors rely on paper ledgers (bahi-khata), risking misplaced records, calculation errors, and missed credit collections.
features: Credit and debit transaction logging with balance calculations
Customer debt records with reminder timestamp tracking
Exportable account transaction histories and summaries
Robust input validation to prevent financial discrepancy records
projects.role: Full-stack developer: formulated the ledger accounting schema in MongoDB, engineered Express CRUD endpoints, and built an intuitive mobile-friendly bookkeeping UI.
projects.challenges: Ensuring transactional consistency during rapid balance ledger entries without race conditions in MongoDB.

projects.name: BRTS Management System
projects.tagline: Bus Rapid Transit System Route & Schedule Optimization
projects.problem: City commuters face difficulty identifying direct bus corridors, transfer stations, and accurate transit schedules across urban networks.
features: Comprehensive corridor and bus station mapping with route search
Timetable scheduling and estimated arrival calculation across stops
Administrator panel for managing bus fleets, drivers, and route additions
Relational MySQL database managing stations, routes, and transit passes
projects.role: Developed the Flask routing server, designed the relational MySQL database schema, and implemented multi-stop transit lookup algorithms.
projects.challenges: Structuring complex relational joins across buses, routes, and transit stops without degrading search query response times.

projects.name: Flappy Bird Recreation (FlappyBirdV1)
projects.problem: Exploring foundational game loops, kinematic physics equations, and high-frequency collision detection in native programming environments.
features: Kinematic gravity and jump acceleration physics model
Bounding-box collision detection for obstacles and floor boundaries
Persistent high score tracker and state machine (Start, Playing, Game Over)
Sprite animation rendering running at 60 FPS
projects.role: Implemented OOP game architecture, physics equations, collision detection logic, and high score persistence.
projects.challenges: Eliminating frame-rate stuttering and input lag on jump trigger events to ensure pixel-perfect collision precision.

faq.question: Does Ronit have full-time corporate work experience?
faq.answer: No. Ronit is currently a 3rd-year B.Tech Information Technology student at LJ University (CGPA 8.41/10). He brings 3+ years of professional freelance video editing experience alongside multiple production-ready full-stack software applications (MetroMind, CinePulse, DigiKhata).

faq.question: What kind of internships is Ronit looking for?
faq.answer: Ronit is looking for Full-Stack Developer, Frontend Developer, or Web Developer internships where he can build scalable user interfaces (React/TypeScript) and robust backends (Node.js/Express, Python/Django REST/Flask, PostgreSQL/MongoDB). His start date and schedule are flexible.

faq.question: What is the best project to look at first?
faq.answer: MetroMind is Ronit's flagship project. It is a full-stack smart metro ticketing platform with a dual-backend architecture: Django REST with scikit-learn for ML crowd density prediction, plus Node.js/Express with MongoDB for commuter bookings and digital passes.
